wizard.title: Install the Ginno browser extension
wizard.connectedBody: Browser tools are ready — head to a session and let the agent drive your Chrome.
wizard.troubleshoot1: "Ginno Browser Connector" appears on the Chrome extensions page and is enabled (if not, go back to step 4 and reload)
wizard.troubleshoot2: No red "Errors" button on the extension card
wizard.troubleshoot3: The Ginno desktop app is running
wizard.troubleshoot4: Click the extension icon and confirm the status is "Connected"; if not, check the port (default 8787)

intro.title: What is this
intro.body: Ginno can work for you inside your own Chrome — using your logged-in sessions, clicking and typing like you would. You can always see what it's doing and stop it at any time. It needs a one-time install of a Ginno browser extension (about 1 minute).

folder.title: Extension files are ready
folder.body: Ginno has placed the extension files in the {path} folder on your computer. Keep this folder open — you'll need it in step 4.

open_extensions.title: Open the Chrome extensions page
open_extensions.body: Type the address below into Chrome's address bar and press Enter (browsers don't allow web pages to open this page directly, so you need to type it yourself):

dev_mode.title: Enable Developer mode
dev_mode.body: There's a "Developer mode" toggle in the top-right corner of the extensions page — turn it on.

load.title: Load the extension
load.body: Click "Load unpacked" in the top-left, then select the browser-extension folder you just opened in the folder picker (note: select the folder itself, don't go inside it), and click "Select". Seeing "Ginno" appear in the list means success.

wait.title: Confirm connection
wait.body: Waiting for the extension to connect back to Ginno…

intro.title: What is this
intro.body: Ginno can be reached from your WeCom app: you chat with the same agent, replies stream into the chat, and your desktop Ginno keeps running the turns.

create_bot.title: Create a smart bot in API mode
create_bot.body: Log in to the WeCom admin console (work.weixin.qq.com) → 应用管理 → 智能机器人 → 创建, choose API 模式 and set the connection method to 使用长连接. No public callback URL is needed.

creds.title: Copy the credentials
creds.body: On the bot's API 配置 page, copy BotID and Secret. Add the bot to a chat (单聊 or 群聊) so users can talk to it.

fill.title: Paste the credentials here and enable
fill.body: Fill BotID/Secret above, optionally restrict allowed userids, then toggle Enabled. The connector card should show Connected within seconds.

intro.title: What is this
intro.body: Vibe Island shows what your AI agents are doing in the Mac notch. With this connector, each Ginno session gets a card there: working or idle, the tool it is running, a completion notice when the turn ends, and a reminder when it needs your answer or approval.

install_app.title: Install Vibe Island
install_app.body: Download the direct-download edition (1.0.53 or newer) from vibeisland.app and open it once. The Mac App Store edition does not support custom agents yet.

enable.title: Enable the connector
enable.body: Toggle Enabled above. New Ginno sessions then show up in the notch — move the pointer to the notch to open the panel, and click a card to jump back to Ginno.

intro.title: What is this
intro.body: Ginno can be reached from your DingTalk: you chat with the same agent, files preview inside DingTalk, and your desktop Ginno keeps running the turns.

create_app.title: Create an internal app on the DingTalk open platform
create_app.body: Log in to open.dingtalk.com with your organization account → 开发配置 → 应用开发 → 企业内部应用 → 创建应用, then add the 机器人 capability.

stream.title: Subscribe to bot messages in Stream mode
stream.body: In the app's 事件订阅 page choose Stream 模式推送 (no public IP needed). Copy the AppKey and AppSecret from 凭证与基础信息.

fill.title: Paste the credentials here and enable
fill.body: Fill AppKey/AppSecret above, optionally restrict allowed staffIds, then toggle Enabled. The connector card should show Connected within seconds.
